title: Forced Marriage
summary: Wang Lin merges with his clone and saves the dying soul of Cheng Xian's Big Ape, making it his third devil. His main body finds Cheng Xian held by his master Sun Hai and learns that Cheng Ling courted him only to get the apes' essence. Li Muwan senses Wang Lin and threatens to end her life unless he shows himself; he appears, tells her he threw away the jade slip she gave him 200 years ago, and she answers that by the founding ancestor's order she will wed Sun Zhenwei in three months, crying that she hates him. Sun Lingwu, the mid Nascent Soul outer master and Sun Zhenwei's father, attacks him for slighting the sect, and Wang Lin smashes a garden's formation to escape. Xu Liguo, sent after Cheng Ling, overhears Sun Zhenwei boast that he will take Li Muwan's 200-year Primordial Yin to form his Nascent Soul, but his attack is blocked by a protective treasure. In the end Wang Lin, as the clone, reveals himself to Li Muwan and asks for pills to reach Nascent Soul in two months so he can kill Sun Zhenwei and carry her across Chu.
events: The clone merges with the main body; the Big Ape's soul becomes Wang Lin's third devil

cultivation: Sun Hai: early Core Formation. Sun Lingwu: mid Nascent Soul. Sun Zhenwei: late Core Formation. Wang Lin's main body shows only late Core Formation but gives off Nascent Soul pressure.
